notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante release dev stream
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Some days ago we announced the QA session with The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante dev team and we must admit it took us some time to make it happen. But hey, we made it! 
Although we couldn't go live due to the significant time difference, we managed to record a 2-hour video and will broadcast it starting from Match 4th, 10 AM PT on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante Steam page.[/url]

Pop in and hear some development stories, The Blessed Arknian Empire lore explanations, and more. The stream will be spoiler-free, so don't hesitate to watch it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39172252/83dfe89f1e259cb50b5add2ec7f6121ad90ac00c.jpg[/img]

If you just landed on our page, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante[/url] is a narrative-driven text-based RPG set in a ruthless medieval realm that comes to life on the pages of the protagonist's journal. The game launches March 4th [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/]on Steam[/url], EGS, GoG, and 101XP store. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272160/The_Life_and_Suffering_of_Sir_Brante/

notes.title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante 26.02 update — full patch notes
notes.notes:
Hey, dear Steamers!

We stand ready to deploy a small patch in order to improve your gaming experience. The update will become available today. Please find the shortlist of changes below:

1. We improved the game parameters balance. During the testing phase, we figured out that some of the personal skills such as Manipulation, Diplomacy, etc. have to be tuned in further in the game's chapter so that gamers can achieve certain events. Thus we had to change a game's balance in the free version of the game as well.
2. Some of the UX/UI elements were slightly enhanced - animated, colored, enlarged, etc. to improve text readability.
3. Performance optimization. The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante is a text-based roleplaying game and it was important for us to make sure it runs smoothly on average gaming PCs. 
4. Windowed mode was added to the Video settings menu which going to improve your streaming experience. 

Add The Life and Suffering of Brante to your wishlist and subscribe to our news so that you don't miss the upcoming release

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1272160
